prompt: DataDashboardComponent with resource(), httpResource(), RxJS catchError, and try/catch for service errors

assertions.name: resource-error-via-signals
assertions.description: Uses resource() with error handling via .status() and/or .error() signals, not ErrorHandler

assertions.name: httpresource-has-value-guard
assertions.description: Guards httpResource .value() reads with .hasValue() to prevent runtime throw in error state

assertions.name: httpresource-error-signal
assertions.description: Displays httpResource errors via .error() signal in template

assertions.name: catcherror-network-vs-backend
assertions.description: RxJS service method uses catchError with HttpErrorResponse, distinguishing status === 0 (network) from status > 0 (backend)

assertions.name: try-catch-for-service-methods
assertions.description: Button handler uses try/catch for service method that can throw, with comment explaining Angular doesn't catch these

assertions.name: resource-error-does-not-reach-errorhandler
assertions.description: Code or comments explicitly state that resource()/httpResource() errors do NOT reach ErrorHandler

assertions.name: httpresource-test-with-controller
assertions.description: Tests use HttpTestingController to test httpResource error state
